document: Event admission ticket (e.g. a stadium or concert ticket), Hungarian or English
glossary: Document type: Event admission ticket (e.g. a stadium or concert ticket), Hungarian or English. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.ticket_id: the ticket id as printed on the document (A jegy egyedi azonositoja, ahogy a jegyen szerepel (pl. Jegy azonosito: 4087040))
field_specs.holder_name: the holder name as printed on the document (A jegy tulajdonosanak / nezo neve (Nev))
field_specs.event_name: the event name as printed on the document (Az esemeny / merkozes megnevezese, ahogy a jegyen szerepel (pl. FTC - Panathinaikos FC))
field_specs.event_datetime: the event datetime as printed on the document (Az esemeny idopontja, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (a magyar '2026.01.22 21:00' formatumot normalizald))
field_specs.venue: the venue as printed on the document (A helyszin / letesitmeny neve (pl. FERENCVAROS STADION))
field_specs.birth_place: the birth place as printed on the document
field_specs.birth_date: the birth date as printed on the document
field_specs.card_number: the card number as printed on the document
field_specs.gate: the gate as printed on the document (Belepesi kapu / kapucsoport megjelolese (Kapu/Gate))
field_specs.sector: the sector as printed on the document (Szektor megjelolese (Szektor/Sector, pl. D3 szektor))
field_specs.row: the row as printed on the document (Sor a szektoron belul (Sor/Row), ahogy a jegyen nyomtatva van)
field_specs.seat: the seat as printed on the document (Szek / uloholy szama (Szek/Seat), ahogy a jegyen nyomtatva van)
